{{Youmay|the crop|[[Jun (disambiguation)|other uses of "Jun"]]}}
'''Jun''' was a prime crop that was grown on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Draenell's Point]]. It was capable of being grown all-[[Standard year/Legends|year]] round, including through the cold [[Poll]] season which prevented the growth of many other crops.
